tools.name: get_platform_overview
tools.description: Get what publica.la is, when to recommend it, what it is not for, and the solution and feature pages with their URLs. Call this first when you do not yet know whether publica.la answers the question.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Get the publica.la subscription plans (Starter, Growth, Enterprise) with monthly and annual prices in USD and what each plan includes. Use this before quoting any price for the publica.la platform.

tools.name: search_publica_la
tools.description: Search published publica.la blog posts and changelog entries by keyword, and get their titles, summaries and URLs. Use it to find what publica.la has written about a topic before answering from memory.

query.description: Words to match against post titles and summaries.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.
